problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Towards One-to-Many Temporal Grounding Temporal Grounding (TG) aims to localize video segments corresponding to a textual query.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Real-world scenarios, however, often require localizing multiple disjoint segments for a single query -- a setting we term One-to-Many Temporal Grounding (OMTG).

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: In particular, the caption reward leverages Chain-of-Thought reasoning over dense video captions to explicitly guide policy optimization toward both preciseness and completeness.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: First, we establish the first comprehensive OMTG benchmark, introducing Count Accuracy (C-Acc) and Effective Temporal F1 (EtF1) as evaluation metrics.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training

methods.name: Pretraining, Pseudo-Labeling, and Data Generation
methods.evidence_sentence: Second, we curate a high-quality OMTG dataset comprising 56k samples through a sophisticated construction pipeline.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: Previous state-of-the-art MLLMs, optimized for one-to-one settings, struggle in this context, often yielding near-zero scores due to a lack of event cardinality perception.
